title: Permission errors now point to a fix
summary:
A day of fixing the edges: actionable permission errors, stored media URLs in the SDK, and image references with commas intact.

Enter now puts a grant link in missing-permission 403 errors and the JSON `fixUrl` field, so owners can add `keys`, `machines`, or `usage` permission to an existing key. The CLI tells users which consent box to select when keys or sandboxes are refused. Keys obtained through a website redirect cannot receive `keys` permission through a grant link; owners can add it on the Keys page.

The SDK's `videoUrl()` and `imageUrl()` now return stored media URLs rather than generation endpoints. The SDK updates also improve usage pagination when records share a timestamp, cancel in-flight device-login polls when aborted, and return refusal text in text and React chat responses.

Image and video generation now preserve commas inside reference URLs such as Cloudinary transformation paths. Comma-separated HTTP URLs and pipe-separated URL lists still work.

daily.title: Grant missing key permissions
daily.text: Owners can use the grant link in Enter's 403 error, also returned as JSON `fixUrl`, to add missing `keys`, `machines`, or `usage` permission to an existing key. For keys obtained through a website redirect, add `keys` permission on the Keys page instead.
